title: Timeline SDK closure expects the platform FFT backend only where the package exports it

installed_sdk.rationale: The consumer closure assertion tolerates an already-exported FFT backend target and changes no SDK header, symbol, or install surface.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No offline timeline command or persisted projection changes.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP operation or response shape changes.

live_product_control.rationale: The CMake closure check adds no runtime product control or grant.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No authoring capability or design-time manifest changes.
